H.scope: Useful improvement on a fixed task with unchanged cap; report task-specific choice, source relevance and covering configurations, never infer new gameplay from labels.

C.scope: Reserved alternate-objective branch if fixed-task choices provide insufficient decision effects; task weighting of legacy domain cannot be diluted.

confirmation.reference: Frozen development-selected physical old configuration per task; confirmation samples estimate that fixed population reference.
confirmation.approximate_inference: Paired Student-t with simultaneous finite contrasts, fixed N; not distribution-free

holdout.method: After selecting a mechanism, deterministic independent 0.9-1.1 multiplicative perturbations to declared research overrides, retaining physical legality and fixed evaluation tasks; a separate held-out setting, not a universal claim.

interpretation: All threshold-grid comparisons are exploratory; only prespecified held-out confirmation effects may be labeled confirmed_local. Mathematical hypotheses and search lineages are not independent proven native mechanisms.
